name: Lucainena de las Torres (Spain)
description: Divided into six panels in two rows, alternating a white tower on blue with white and blue wavy stripes.
history: The creation of the flag was decided by the municipal council on 14 August 1996 and entrusted to the heraldist José Luis Ruz Márquez, who based it on the first quarter of the arms; it is described as a rectangular silk or taffeta cloth one and a half times longer than wide, divided into six equal parts, three above and three below, alternating a white tower on blue with white and blue waves.

features.role: white towers on the blue panels
wavy stripes on the alternate panels
